gated SPECT is a reliable and accurate tool for LVEF measurement.

gated SPECT is more reliable than echocardiography and contrast ventriculo-cardiography in the assessment of LVD and LVEF, and that LVEF as determined by echocardiograpy is more reliable than LVEF as assessed by contrast angiography.

gated SPECT is the preferred method to measure LLEF, because: (i) it is a quantitative technique, (ii) the LVEF values determined by gated SPECT have the highest prognostic value, (iii) gated SPECT is more accurate in measuring LVEF than 2D echocardiographic techniques, and (iv) gated SPECT has a better accuracy than contrast ventriculograms.
